basic_info.description: Spacious and contemporary 1 bedroom plus den, 2 bathroom loft condominium located at the Iconic Ironworks building. Flooded with natural light and featuring oversized double height windows and gorgeous refinished wood floors. The entry with large closet leads to the living/dining/great room with handsome gas fireplace and soaring ceilings, remodeled chef's kitchen with new stainless refrigerator, microwave and gas range, new quartz counters, custom cabinets and dishwasher. Large alcove office/guest space and full updated bathroom with new modern vanity and shower over soaking tub on the main level. The large mezzanine bedroom has a walk-in closet and room for a sitting area. The primary bath has a new custom vanity and large walk-in shower. In unit washer/dryer. One car parking and roof deck with downtown views in a boutique elevator building. Ideal SOMA location close to Columbia Square park, Yerba Buena Gardens, Whole Foods, CalTrain and MUNI
